title: Offensive Rebound Tip Drill
description: A player tosses the ball off the backboard themselves and tips it back in repeatedly, building quick hands and timing for offensive rebounds.

content.objective: Attack the ball at its highest point and tip it back toward the rim with soft touch.
content.setup: A player stands under the basket and tosses the ball off the backboard to themselves.
instructions: Toss the ball softly off the backboard above the rim.
Jump to meet the ball at its highest point and tip it back toward the rim.
Repeat continuously for ten tips without letting the ball touch the floor.
Alternate tipping with the right hand, then the left hand.
coachingPoints: Jump to the ball rather than waiting for it to come down.
Use the fingertips for a soft tip, not a hard slap.
Keep both hands ready in case the first tip needs a follow-up.
commonMistakes: Waiting at the floor level instead of attacking the ball in the air.
Tipping too hard and sending the ball away from the rim.
Watching the shot instead of immediately finding a body to box out.
content.safety: Only one player under the rim at a time during the drill.
